units.source_text: 在树干弯曲的下方，有两个小洞，紫花地丁就分别寄生在那儿，并且每到春天就开花。

en.t: Below the bend in the tree trunk were two small hollows, and violets had taken root there separately, blooming every spring.

units.source_text: 打千重子懂事的时候起，那树上就有两株紫花地丁了。

en.t: Ever since Chieko could remember, there had been two violet plants on that tree.
